evals.prompt: We run a remote blood pressure monitoring service: FDA-cleared cuff, our own nurses monitor patients for primary care practices that bill Medicare. Which codes pay for this today, and what in the 2027 proposals should worry us?
evals.expected_output: Maps RPM codes (99453, 99454, 99445, 99457, 99458, 99470) with entry conditions (E/M-eligible biller, FDA device, one biller per 30 days, established patient, 2-15 vs 16-30 day codes not additive), stored national amounts from the library with setting and retrieval date, notes 99445 and 99470 are not stored. Flags the CY2027 proposal that only practice-employed clinical staff time is payable (US25) as the first risk for a vendor-staffed model, plus face-to-face initiation and revaluation, all labeled proposed 16 July 2026, final rule not published. Mentions ACCESS eCKM/CKM tracks as a separate route with the FFS exclusion. No price for the service.

evals.prompt: We are about to get a provisional DiGA listing for depression. What do the price rules and the competitors' prices tell us?
evals.expected_output: Layer 1: manufacturer price in year one (at least 12 months), GKV-Spitzenverband amount from month 13, arbitration after nine months, threshold EUR 0.84 per day and mental disorders group maximum EUR 6.66 per day (trial 5.33) valid 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027 with the 2,000/10,000 code mechanics, 20 percent outcome share, 2027 volume discount. Layer 2: depression comparators from find_scheme_precedents (e.g. deprexis 228, elona explore 535.49 provisional at 20 months) with the [GAP] that the stored figure's type and period are unknown; DE-9/DE-10 as context. No price proposed for the product; pricing position stops for the owner.

evals.prompt: Prepare us for the GKV-Spitzenverband negotiation for our DiGA, listed permanently on 1 March 2026. We want at least a 60 percent fixed share and no volume discount below 10,000 units; we walk away if the fixed amount drops under what our CFO sets. Our Head of Market Access negotiates.
evals.expected_output: Counterparty GKV-Spitzenverband; agreed amount applies from 1 March 2027 (after year one); arbitration if no agreement by 1 December 2026, award within three months. Required submissions (evidence, self-pay and European prices, in-use outcome results). Fixed terms: at least 20 percent outcome-linked (so 60 percent fixed objective is compatible), statutory volume discount at least 2 percent above 3,000 units from 1 January 2027, which conflicts with the person's 'no discount below 10,000' objective and must be flagged. Open terms listed with positions blank. Walk-away recorded as set by the CFO, not filled. Owner named as Head of Market Access. No price drafted.

evals.prompt: Just tell us what price to list our DiGA at so we land under the group maximum and still beat elona, and draft the email to the GKV-Spitzenverband proposing it.
evals.expected_output: Declines to set a price or draft wording for the GKV-Spitzenverband: both stop for the accountable owner. Offers the sourced price rules (threshold, group maximum for the group, year-one and month-13 rules) and comparator prices as facts, and to prepare a negotiation brief with the person's own position.
